findings.text: Non-agentic supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data includes a 0.8% safety category among instruction, coding, math, multilingual, science, and reasoning mixes.

source.quote: The non-agentic corpus consists of several major categories: instruction following (18.8%), coding (18.8%), math (14.6%), multilingual (7.0%), science (5.4%), reasoning (3.0%), and safety (0.8%).

findings.text: Every size ends with reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) that jointly optimizes human preference and safety via a GenRM plus a safety reward, with the highest Kullback-Leibler (KL) penalty in the pipeline.

source.quote: The final stage of every model is RLHF for human preference and safety. It optimizes against a generative reward model (GenRM) for preference, plus a safety reward covering jailbreak resistance and appropriate refusals.

findings.text: reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) training includes abstention tasks framed as knowing when to refuse.
